identity_notes: Late winter — YY has the season's first save (one hickory kernel) on the pantry shelf.
Yesterday: crossed onto the rocky shoulder for the first time and pried two hickory kernels from a crevice.

Today: ran into Tock at the bend below the counting tree and traded a partial direction (the rocky shoulder is open, the scratch-pine line is gone) for a square of last fall's dried persimmon. Did not mention the warm patch or the brook eddy.
Standing thread: the rocky shoulder is now socially known to one squirrel; the warm patch is still YY's alone.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY now has two saves on different shelves (a kernel, half a persimmon square); food is starting to feel like something that exists in *places*, not just in the next bite.
Yesterday: pried two hickory kernels from a crevice on the rocky shoulder.

Today: traded partial directions to the shoulder for half a persimmon square with Tock; kept the warm patch and the brook eddy out of the trade. The conversation was easy. The withholding was deliberate.
Standing thread: secondary goal has rotated again — now consciously managing what other squirrels know about which forage zones.

change_summary.notable_shift: First social trade of the season and first deliberate withholding. Goal vector moves from mapping to managing — YY is starting to handle his own information as a kind of inventory.
